# homarr_user (Data Source)

Looks up a single Homarr user by `id` or by `username`. Exactly one of the two must be set.

Reports the account and its preferences: the attributes of the `homarr_user` resource except the password and the groups, which Homarr never reports, plus the profile image. Unlike the resource it reads any account, including those backed by LDAP or OIDC, so it suits accounts that Terraform should reference without managing them.

Any API key may use it. A lookup by `username` lists users through `GET /api/users/selectable`, which is open to every key. Homarr shows the details of a user other than the key's own only to an admin, though: for any other key the data source reports just what that list holds — `id`, `username`, `provider_name`, `email` and `image` — leaves the preferences and `header` null, and says so in a warning. For the key's own account, `homarr_current_user` needs no id or name.

~> **`header` requires Homarr 2.3.0 or newer.** On an older release it is `null`, and a warning says so; everything else is read from `GET /api/users/{id}` and works on any 2.x release.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an account by name. Usernames are unique only per auth provider, so
# provider_name picks the LDAP account if a credentials one shares its name.
data "homarr_user" "jdoe" {
  username      = "jdoe"
  provider_name = "ldap"
}

# ...or by id.
data "homarr_user" "by_id" {
  id = "k723ruvksaauzjvapxpmt9f6"
}

# Manage the preferences of an account Terraform did not create.
resource "homarr_user_preferences" "jdoe" {
  user_id       = data.homarr_user.jdoe.id
  home_board_id = homarr_board.infra.id
}

# The header layout has the shape the resources take, so one user's layout can
# be copied onto another, provided that user can view its board shortcuts.
resource "homarr_user" "intern" {
  username = "intern"
  password = var.intern_password
  header   = data.homarr_user.jdoe.header
}

output "jdoe_email" {
  value = data.homarr_user.jdoe.email
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Identifier of the user to look up. Exactly one of `id` and `username` must be set.
- `provider_name` (String) Auth provider the user signs in through: `credentials`, `oidc` or `ldap`. Set it along with `username` to only consider users of that provider; it cannot be combined with `id`.
- `username` (String) Login name of the user to look up. Exactly one of `id` and `username` must be set.

Surrounding whitespace and case are ignored: Homarr lowercases the names of credentials accounts, while LDAP and OIDC accounts keep the name their provider supplies. The attribute then reports the name as Homarr stores it. Usernames are unique only per auth provider, so when an LDAP or OIDC account shares the name of another account the lookup fails; set `provider_name` to pick one.

### Read-Only

- `byte_unit_system` (String) How byte sizes are displayed: `binary` (KiB, MiB) or `decimal` (kB, MB).
- `color_scheme` (String) Interface colour scheme: `auto`, `light` or `dark`.
- `ddg_bangs` (Boolean) Whether DuckDuckGo-style `!bang` shortcuts work in the search bar.
- `default_search_engine_id` (String) Identifier of the search engine used by the search bar, or `null` for none.
- `email` (String) Email address of the user, or `null` when it has none.
- `enable_right_click_on_widgets` (Boolean) Whether widgets handle right-clicks instead of the browser context menu.
- `first_day_of_week` (Number) First day of the week in calendar widgets, `0` for Sunday through `6` for Saturday.
- `header` (Attributes) Layout of the header bar shown above boards. It has the shape the `header` attribute of `homarr_user` and `homarr_user_preferences` takes, so a layout read here can be copied onto another user.

~> **Requires Homarr 2.3.0 or newer.** On an older release it is `null`, and a warning says so. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--header))
- `home_board_id` (String) Board shown to the user on desktop, or `null` for none.
- `image` (String) Profile image of the user, or `null` when it has none: a `data:` URL of an uploaded picture, which can be up to 350,000 characters long, or the picture URL an OIDC provider supplied.
- `mobile_home_board_id` (String) Board shown to the user on mobile, or `null` for none.
- `open_search_in_new_tab` (Boolean) Whether search results open in a new browser tab.
- `ping_icons_enabled` (Boolean) Whether online-status ping indicators are shown as icons rather than dots.

<a id="nestedatt--header"></a>
### Nested Schema for `header`

Read-Only:

- `center` (Attributes List) Items in the center zone, in display order; `[]` when it is empty. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--header--center))
- `left` (Attributes List) Items in the left zone, in display order; `[]` when it is empty. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--header--left))
- `logo_display` (String) How the `logo` item is shown: `logo` or `logoAndText`.
- `right` (Attributes List) Items in the right zone, in display order; `[]` when it is empty. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--header--right))
- `search_display` (String) How the `search` item is shown: `input` or `icon`.
- `visible` (Boolean) Whether the header is shown.

<a id="nestedatt--header--center"></a>
### Nested Schema for `header.center`

Read-Only:

- `board_id` (String) Identifier of the board linked to, or `null` for a builtin control.
- `builtin` (String) The builtin control, such as `logo`, `search` or `user`, or `null` for a board shortcut.

- `builtin` (String) The builtin control, such as `logo`, `search` or `user`, or `null` for a board shortcut.
